idea-plugin.name: Nexus MCP for Unreal Engine
idea-plugin.description:
Connect AI clients to Unreal Engine from JetBrains Rider. Nexus MCP is the Rider integration for NexusLink — Unreal Engine MCP. With NexusLink installed in UE, use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to inspect project context, work with Blueprints and materials, and debug running sessions.

Discover running UE projects, generate AI client configuration, and switch instances from Rider's status bar. This plugin provides the local MCP relay (default port 6800); Blueprints, assets, PIE control, and other engine capabilities come from NexusLink.

Requires the UE plugin: Fab (listed as NexusMCP) · NexusLink (GitHub) · Download (Releases). Install NexusLink from Fab for your engine version, or extract a release ZIP so that Plugins/NexusLink/NexusLink.uplugin exists in your project. Enable it, then turn on Editor Preferences > Plugins > NexusLink > Enable MCP Server.

Getting started:

  • Open a project in Rider (the MCP server starts per project, not on the welcome screen)
  • Enable it under Settings > Tools > Nexus MCP (disabled by default)
  • Choose MCP client configuration… in settings, select your AI client and protocol, and paste the generated configuration, including authentication, into your AI client

Features:

  • Standalone Netty-based MCP HTTP server (Streamable HTTP + SSE), per-session isolation
  • Automatic discovery of multiple UE instances via port scanning
  • Connect / switch between UE instances from the status bar
  • Transparent tool proxying; per-call targetPort routing for multi-instance queries

Source & docs: github.com/bytepine/NexusRider. All network traffic is bound to 127.0.0.1 by default; LAN bind is optional. No telemetry is collected.

在 JetBrains Rider 中连接 AI 与 Unreal Engine。 Nexus MCP 是 NexusLink — Unreal Engine MCP 的 Rider 客户端。配合 UE 侧 NexusLink，通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）让 AI 读取项目上下文、处理蓝图与材质，并调试运行状态。

在 Rider 中自动发现 UE 项目、生成 AI 客户端配置，并从状态栏切换实例。 本插件提供本地 MCP 中转（默认端口 6800）；蓝图、资产、PIE 等引擎能力由 NexusLink 提供。

需配合 UE 插件： Fab（商品名 NexusMCP） · NexusLink（GitHub） · 下载（Releases）。 从 Fab 安装适配引擎版本的 NexusLink；或解压 Release ZIP，确认项目中存在 Plugins/NexusLink/NexusLink.uplugin。启用后在 Editor Preferences > Plugins > NexusLink > Enable MCP Server 勾选开启。

快速开始：

  • 在 Rider 中打开一个项目（MCP 服务器按项目启动，欢迎界面不启动）
  • 在 Settings > Tools > Nexus MCP 勾选启用（默认关闭）
  • 在设置中选择「MCP 客户端配置…」，选好 AI 客户端与协议，将包含身份验证的生成配置粘贴到 AI 客户端

功能：

  • 独立的基于 Netty 的 MCP HTTP 服务器（Streamable HTTP + SSE），按会话隔离
  • 通过端口扫描自动发现多个 UE 实例
  • 在状态栏连接 / 切换 UE 实例
  • 透明转发工具调用；多实例查询支持按调用指定 targetPort

源码与文档： github.com/bytepine/NexusRider。 默认绑定 127.0.0.1，可改为局域网监听。不采集任何遥测数据。
